sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Access Control Policy defines requirements for limiting access to {system_name} operated by {org_name}. It applies across the system boundary described as {boundary} and protects Controlled Unclassified Information including {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. User and System Identification

questions.prompt: How are authorized processes acting for users identified?

sections.body: Authorized users are identified through {authorized_users_id}. Processes acting on behalf of authorized users are identified through {authorized_processes_id}. System devices authorized to connect are identified through {authorized_devices_id}.

sections.heading: 3. Access Limitation and Enforcement

questions.prompt: How is user system access limited to authorized users?
How is process access limited to authorized processes?
How is device access limited to authorized devices?

sections.body: System access for users is limited through {user_access_enforcement}. System access for processes is limited through {process_access_enforcement}. System access for devices is limited through {device_access_enforcement}.

sections.heading: 4. Permitted Transactions and Functions

questions.prompt: How are permitted transaction and function types defined for authorized users?
How is system access limited to permitted transaction and function types?

sections.body: Permitted transaction and function types are defined by {permitted_transactions_def}. Enforcement of permitted transaction and function limits is performed by {permitted_transactions_enf}.
